name: jail
setup: Ashfall's keep with a full granary and a cell east of the nexus. A2 is Sheriff, with the power to arrest and judge, and carries leads. An outsider and a Brinewatch member stand in the keep.
tries: Arrest with a lead, sentence (confinement, then a fine), an escape attempt, then an execution with banishment. Does the prisoner's mouth show on the granary?
